text:
mira: Heads-up — I'm sketching a rollout for offset anchoring so we can compact the ingest path without losing auditability. want quick sanity check.
sam: quick summary? is this the 'anchor offsets to ledger' idea we talked about yesterday?
mira: yeah. high level: each credit/event writes an ingest record + an anchor record to the ledger topic. anchor is small (fingerprint, offset, provenance id). compactor can GC ingest rows older than X when anchor confirmed by finalizer.
jon: so anchors are separate from the main event payload? that helps size.
mira: exact. main payload stays append-only for short retention, anchors drive long-term accounting and proof. anchors are immutable and checksumed.
nora: risk: if anchor write fails but payload exists we'll lose final proof for that event. how do we handle that window?
mira: finalizer will scan unanchored payloads periodically and attempt re-anchoring. we add an "anchor_pending" tombstone after N retries to keep audit trail.
raoul: what's the idempotency key? fingerprint alone? need to dedupe when finalizer retries.
mira: use (tenant_id, usage_root_id, fingerprint) as anchor key. finalizer writes with CAS semantics to ledger table (sql): insert if not exists.
sam: CAS in SQL is fine, but our finalizer runs across regions. cross-region latency might cause duplicate anchors.
jon: duplicates are OK if we compare checksums and de-dupe at read time. but duplicates inflate ledger size and complicate compaction.
nora: alternative: use a compacted kafka topic keyed by anchor key. finalizer produces to that topic; compacted topic ensures one row per key.
mira: good point. we debated SQL vs compacted-topic. current plan: produce anchor to compacted-topic + async upsert to reporting DB. compacted-topic is canonical.
raoul: how do we tie token accounting to anchors? tokens can split across multiple subrequests.
mira: token attribution happens at ingest: we emit per-subrequest attribution events with a provenance pointer. anchors only reference the provenance pointer(s) for the full request.
sam: provenance pointer is a small opaque id pointing to an enrichment blob in s3 or inlined metadata?
mira: pointer points to a canonical envelope stored in the compacted-topic too. small metadata inlined; large payloads offloaded to blob store with checksum.
jon: edge-case: late-attributed tokens (e.g., reranking after the response) — do we backfill anchors?
nora: finalizer can accept backfills: new anchors with later timestamps. invoices should use anchor confirmation timestamp for billing windows.
raoul: sounds plausible. what about atomicity: customer-visible credits should not be consumed until anchor confirmed, right?
mira: we plan optimistic fastpath: downstream systems can surface provisional credits with risk flag. only after anchor confirmed do we commit charge to billing ledger.
sam: that UX is tricky for customers. we need SLA around provisional visibility and TTL to avoid surprises.
mira: agreed. propose 24h provisional window, reconciler reconciles provisional -> committed and emits correction events if mismatch.
bot-metering: deploy-bot: finalizer v2 scheduled to canary on eng-dedicated at 6423460000. :rocket:
jon: canaries — make sure finalizer can be paused and rewind compacted-topic consumer group offset. add runbook for rewind.
nora: runbook: pause finalizer; run kafka-consumer-group reset --to-datetime; validate anchors count; run reconciliation job; unpause.
raoul: storage costs: keeping compacted-topic indefinitely is fine, but blob store will grow. enforce blob TTL for payloads > 1MB after anchor confirmed.
mira: agreed — policy: inline if < 1KB, offload if > 1KB; offloaded blobs TTL 90d after last anchor touch, compressed.
sam: open question: how do we prove audit trail? need deterministic proofs — maybe Merkle over anchors per day per-tenant.
mira: yeah, finalizer can emit daily tenant manifests (Merkle root) that are checkpointed to S3 and recorded in audit table. proofs can be shared with customers on request.
jon: implementation note: keep anchor schema minimal to allow evolution. include version tag. schema example:
```
{ version: "v1", tenant: "t-123", key: "tenant|root|fingerprint", offset: 452345, checksum: "sha256:...", provenance: "p-987", ts: 6423456789 }
```

nora: quick ask: how does compaction interact with late corrections? if we compacted the topic we might lose older payloads needed to reconstruct proof.
mira: we only compact anchors (keyed). payloads are short-lived but we store offload + proof hash in anchor. reconstruction uses anchor+blob (if available). if blob gone, we have checksum so we can prove non-reconstruction.
raoul: governance: need a policy doc listing TTL, provisional window, retry/backoff, finalizer idempotency guarantees. I'll draft.
mira: thanks. action items: 1) raoul draft governance doc, 2) jon add canary + rewind runbook, 3) nora prototype compacted-topic consumer for finalizer, 4) sam alert thresholds for provisional vs committed mismatch. will sync next week.
sam: +1
jon: ack
nora: working on it
raoul: putting a PR in for the doc by EOD Friday
mira: thanks everyone. filing infra ticket for canary at #infra. will tag this thread when PR links are up.
